task: Limit Chaos Mesh to the chaos-testing namespace and run its controller manager non-root (CIS 5.1.x RBAC and 5.2/5.7 pod security)

events.summary: D-OWN-CHAOS requires namespace-scoped experiments, explicit RBAC, removal of unused Secret verbs, and a non-root controller. D-CHAOS-OWN-RBAC replaces the chart grants with controller-only RBAC in the same Application.

The orchestrator's 2026-11-26 trial of the first attempt observed four controller restarts and repeated denied RemoteCluster list requests with clusterScoped=false and ENABLED_CONTROLLERS=*. The target ClusterRole still contained wildcard and Secret write grants.
evidence: test:orchestrator .omc/live/remediation/chaos-trial2.txt -> Synced/Healthy, controller restart count 4, failed RemoteCluster list, target RoleBinding and original ClusterRole rules
test:helm template chaos-mesh .review/chart/chaos-mesh -n chaos-testing --set extraObjects[0].kind=ServiceAccount -> undefined external-secrets.render helper

events.summary: Disable chart RBAC and load the explicit controller ServiceAccount, Roles and bindings from the same Argo CD Application's Git source. Keep RemoteCluster cache reads at cluster scope and Secret/PVC reads in chaos-testing. The daemon ServiceAccount remains chart-rendered. Pin controller UID/GID 65532 and RuntimeDefault seccomp.

events.scope: Static checks (R406, R364) plus a pre-merge live trial on the local cluster (branch files pushed to Gitea, reverted afterwards).
evidence: test:helm template chaos-mesh .review/chart/chaos-mesh -n chaos-testing -f extracted values --include-crds -> no chart Roles, ClusterRoles or bindings. Combined Application: 1 ClusterRole, 2 Roles, 1 ClusterRoleBinding, 2 RoleBindings, no wildcard RBAC rules, both workload ServiceAccounts present.

test:live trial before merge (branch files pushed with push-to-gitea.sh, 2026-11-26, chaos-trial3): controller UID/GID 65532, 0 restarts and 0 forbidden log lines over 12 min; only chaos-controller-manager-cluster ClusterRoleBinding and two RoleBindings in chaos-testing; PodChaos pod-kill Selected/AllInjected with Apply:Succeeded and the target pod deleted; auth can-i delete pods -n devtools -> no, list remoteclusters -> yes; after reverting to main the Application returned to Synced/Healthy and the explicit RBAC was pruned

events.summary: Chart RBAC is off and the explicit least-privilege RBAC lives in gitops/resources/chaos-mesh-rbac.yaml (second source of the same Application), pinned by R406. The pre-merge live trial ran the controller stably non-root and executed a PodChaos in chaos-testing; other experiment kinds (NetworkChaos, StressChaos, Schedule, Workflow) were not exercised.
Complete within the stated scope (explicit RBAC, non-root controller, static checks and a pre-merge live trial of PodChaos).
